headline: MiniMax's flash model sets an all-time share record at 13.7% and climbs to #2
summary: minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash-20261019:free just set an all-time token-share record at 13.7% after a six-spot jump to #2. DeepSeek still runs the top of the board, and the top two providers now hold 42.9% between them.
highlights: DeepSeek's deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 keeps the #1 spot at 14.5%, which is not a bad place to park.
MiniMax is up 9.2% as a provider on the day, the biggest one-day provider share gain on the board, now sitting at 14.4%.
The top three providers, DeepSeek, MiniMax and Zhipu AI, hold 51.4% combined.
StepFun's stepfun/step-5-preview-20261008 debuts at #13 with a 2.0% share.
OpenAI's openai/gpt-5.6-sol-20260709 enters the rankings at #47.
Two models fell off the board: nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b-20230311:free and google/gemini-3.7-flash-20260813.
